target.title: fix(nvidia): sync recommended models with featured catalog
target.body:
## Summary

Keeps OpenClaw's recommended NVIDIA Endpoint models aligned with NVIDIA's authoritative seven-row featured-model catalog while preserving all five shipped deprecated refs for exact-reference compatibility. New onboarding and selectable catalog surfaces expose only the seven current featured models.

### What Problem This Solves

NVIDIA Endpoint users could see outdated recommended models and metadata after NVIDIA updated its featured catalog. Removing the shipped rows entirely would also discard compatibility metadata needed by existing configurations.

## Changes

- Refresh the bundled selectable catalog with Nemotron 3 Ultra, Nemotron 3 Super, GLM 5.2, Kimi K2.6, MiniMax M3, DeepSeek V4 Pro, and Qwen3.5 397B A17B using values from NVIDIA's featured-model JSON.
- Retain Kimi K2.5, GLM 5.1, MiniMax M2.5, GLM-5, and MiniMax M2.7 as deprecated exact-reference rows in the full NVIDIA provider catalog.
- Route NVIDIA onboarding, static selection, live selection, and augmented picker catalogs through selectable-only builders so deprecated rows never appear in new model choices.
- Match feed-provided names, context windows, and max-output values: Ultra is `1,048,576 / 8,192`, Super is `1,000,000 / 8,192`, and DeepSeek/Qwen are `262,144 / 16,384`.
- Update NVIDIA provider documentation and focused catalog/onboarding tests.

### Why This Change Was Made

NVIDIA's public `featured-models.json` is the source of truth for current recommendations. The NVIDIA plugin now separates the full compatibility catalog from selectable surfaces: current models remain easy to choose, while existing users retain exact-reference metadata and `requiresStringContent` compatibility for every shipped ref.

## Validation

### Evidence

Ran the actual PR-head NVIDIA provider builders against the live NVIDIA feed:

```sh
corepack pnpm exec tsx -e '<build full, selectable, and live NVIDIA providers>'
```

Observed on head `ac37487207b2f342202df73b71c38bf90005d3cc`:

```text
full:       12 rows = 7 featured + 5 deprecated exact-reference rows
selectable:  7 rows = current featured rows; all deprecated rows absent
live:        7 rows = current featured rows; all deprecated rows absent
```

The five compatibility-only IDs present in `full` and absent from both selectable outputs are:

```text
moonshotai/kimi-k2.5
z-ai/glm-5.1
minimaxai/minimax-m2.5
z-ai/glm5
minimaxai/minimax-m2.7
```

Focused validation:

- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/nvidia/provider-catalog.test.ts extensions/nvidia/index.test.ts extensions/nvidia/onboard.test.ts` — 30 tests passed.
- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/commands/model-picker.test.ts` — 64 tests passed with the shared picker files unchanged.
- `git diff --check`, documentation listing, and NVIDIA manifest JSON validation — passed.
- Current-head checks — 62 successful, 56 intentionally skipped, 9 superseded cancellations, 0 actionable failures.
- Fresh autoreview — no accepted/actionable findings.

## Notes

### User Impact

New NVIDIA setup and model-selection flows show the current seven featured models. If live discovery is unavailable, the selectable bundled fallback presents the same seven-model set. Existing configurations using any of the five shipped older refs retain their metadata and remain resolvable by exact reference, while those deprecated rows stay out of onboarding and model pickers.
